qa_pairs.question: The growth rate of the user scale in the knowledge payment market is gradually slowing down, and at the same time, the user's content consumption preferences show an obvious concentration trend. To improve user engagement and market revenue, how should the allocation of content resources be optimized? Please select the most reasonable strategic suggestion:

answer.A: Give priority to increasing investment in the development of short - video and live - broadcast content. User content preferences show that short - videos and live - broadcasts are the mainstream forms. Combining with the trend that the user scale base continues to expand but the growth rate declines, focusing on high - demand content can more efficiently attract new users and enhance the activity of existing users, thereby optimizing resource utilization.
answer.B: Given that short - videos account for as high as 75.7% in user preferences, all graphic and text and audio content should be eliminated, and all resources should be concentrated on short - video development.
answer.C: Expand brand advertising to increase market awareness and attract more new users to enter the knowledge payment field.
answer.D: Strengthen the innovation and differentiation of graphic and text and audio content. Although the proportion of graphic and text and audio in user preferences is relatively low, there is still a stable user group. Considering that the market size growth rate is predicted to gradually slow down, mining segmented needs through content innovation can avoid over - relying on a single form and enhance the overall market resilience.
answer.E: Reduce resource investment in other content types and transfer funds to leading fields such as short - videos. User preference data shows that other types have the lowest acceptance. Combining with the prediction that both the market size and user scale growth rates will slow down, reducing inefficient investment can concentrate resources to capture high - growth potential opportunities.
answer.F: Improve the training quality of content creators to ensure the same professional level for all content types (such as short - videos, live - broadcasts, graphic and text, etc.).
answer.G: Since the user scale growth rate has declined from 95.8% in 2016 to 4.8% in 2025E, the investment in new content development should be significantly reduced, and the focus should be shifted to maintaining the existing content library to reduce costs.

label: A
D
E
